name: Auto-rotate
author: Niko Maroulis
description: Rotate the built-in display from the accelerometer on 2-in-1 laptops, in tablet mode or always, with a rotation lock in the bar. Ships a helper that installs the laptop's OEM sensor hub firmware on Intel Lunar Lake and newer.

barWidget.description: Rotation lock: click to lock, right-click to cycle tablet / always / off

schema.label: Hide the icon while the screen is not auto-rotating
